copy.curiosityHook: With Nazi forces closing in, Jo must rely on an old World War I adversary to steer a desperate family across guarded frontiers.
copy.description: En route to the Berlin Olympics, French boxer Jo Cavalier meets a young Jewish orphan in peril, abandoning his athletic ambitions to launch a wild, high-stakes escape to the Swiss border.
copy.vibeSummary: Fast-paced, exciting, and lightly comic, balancing wartime tension with crowd-pleasing action.
copy.whyWatch: Director Gérard Oury turns a wartime chase into a kinetic, good-humored adventure fueled by quick wits, classic comic escapism, and spirited camaraderie.
